newsitem.title: TURKEY: Five jailed for stealing Turk businessman corpse.
newsitem.headline: Five jailed for stealing Turk businessman corpse.

text.p: A Turkish criminal court sentenced five people to over four years in jail on Wednesday for stealing the body of the late Turkish industrialist Vehbi Koc, Anatolian news agency said.
"Five suspects who had taken out the body of late businessman Vehbi Koc's body from its grave...were sentenced to four years and seven months in jail," the state-run agency said.
Koc's remains, stolen from an Istanbul cemetary in October last year, were found in a neighbouring empty grave six weeks later.
The suspects admitted they had stolen the body and planned to demand a ransom from Koc family of 3,995,000 German marks ($2.3 million), Anatolian said.
Vehbi Koc led an industrial empire with a turnover of $8.2 billion and 32,700 employees. He died aged 95 in February 1996.
Koc Holding Company is now run by his son Rahmi.
